condition.narrative: As per the ESCP the grievance mechanism shall be reinforce and publicized no later than 6 months after the effective date and shallbe maintained operational throughout project implementation

Per the ESCP ESF related training will be undertaken for relevant MoH/GHS/NHIA staff and consultants, district level implementingagencies staff, no later than 90 days after the effective date and periodically when new project team members/consultants join theproject throughout implementation

Schedule 2, Section I.A No later than six (6) months from the Effective Date, establish and thereafter maintain throughout theimplementation of the Operation, a Verification Oversight Committee with terms of reference agreed with the Association, which teamshall comprise respected individuals from academic and the non-governmental sector, and be responsible for reviewing verificationreports before they are transmitted to the government by the Verification Agent as further detailed in the Operation Manual.

Schedule 2, Section I.D.1 Appoint by not later than six (6) months after the Effective Date, and thereafter maintain at all timeduring the implementation of the Program, one or more independent verification agents with experience and qualifications and underterms of reference acceptable to the Association (the “Verification Agents”), to: (i) verify the data and other evidence supportingthe achievement of the DLIs/DLRs, as set forth in the table in Schedule 3 to this Agreement; and (ii) recommend correspondingdisbursements to be made, as applicable, pursuant to such Schedule 3 and Section IV.
